# JSON Tools

> Free online JSON, CSV, XML, YAML, and developer tools. No signup, no data sent to servers, 100% client-side.

JSON Tools is a collection of free browser-based developer utilities for working with JSON and common data formats. All processing happens locally in the browser — no data is ever transmitted to any server.

## Available Tools

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, and minify JSON with syntax highlighting and error detection.
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/csv-to-json): Convert CSV and TSV files to JSON. Auto-detect delimiters, headers, and data types.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-to-csv): Flatten JSON arrays to CSV. Handles nested objects and arrays.
- [XML to JSON Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/xml-to-json): Convert XML documents to clean JSON. Handles attributes and nested elements.
- [JSON to XML Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-to-xml): Convert JSON objects to valid XML with configurable root element and formatting.
- [YAML to JSON Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/yaml-to-json): Parse YAML files and convert them to JSON instantly.
- [JSON to YAML Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-to-yaml): Convert JSON to YAML with proper indentation and formatting.
- [Excel to JSON Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/excel-to-json): Upload .xlsx or .xls files and convert spreadsheet data to JSON.
- [JSON to Excel Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-to-excel): Export JSON arrays to downloadable Excel spreadsheets.
- [JSON Diff](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-diff): Compare two JSON objects side-by-side. Highlights added, removed, and changed values.
- [JSON Tree Viewer](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-tree): Visualize JSON as an interactive collapsible tree or node graph. Copy paths with one click.
- [JSON Schema Generator](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-schema): Generate JSON Schema (Draft-07 or 2020-12) from any JSON sample.
- [JSON to TypeScript / Zod](https://jsontools.space/tools/json-to-ts): Generate TypeScript interfaces or Zod schemas from JSON.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://jsontools.space/tools/base64): Encode text or files to Base64, decode Base64 strings. Supports URL-safe variant.
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://jsontools.space/tools/url-encode): Encode special characters for URLs or decode percent-encoded strings.
- [JWT Decoder](https://jsontools.space/tools/jwt-decoder): Decode and inspect JWT tokens. Displays header, payload, and signature without verification.
- [Hash Generator](https://jsontools.space/tools/hash): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes from any text input.
- [Regex Tester](https://jsontools.space/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions with live match highlighting. Supports flags and capture groups.
- [Cron Parser](https://jsontools.space/tools/cron-parser): Parse and explain cron expressions in plain English. Shows next execution times.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/unix-timestamp): Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates. Supports seconds and milliseconds.
- [UUID Generator](https://jsontools.space/tools/uuid): Generate random UUID v4 identifiers. Bulk generation up to 100, multiple format options.
- [CSS Minifier](https://jsontools.space/tools/css-minifier): Minify CSS with lightningcss to reduce file size. Client-side only.
- [HTML Minifier](https://jsontools.space/tools/html-minifier): Minify HTML, including embedded CSS and JS, to reduce file size. Client-side only.
- [JavaScript Minifier](https://jsontools.space/tools/js-minifier): Minify JavaScript with terser (mangling, dead-code elimination) to reduce file size. Client-side only.
- [SQL Formatter](https://jsontools.space/tools/sql-formatter): Format and beautify SQL queries. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, T-SQL, and standard SQL.
- [Text Case Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/text-case): Convert text between camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, kebab-case, UPPER_CASE, and more.
- [Number Base Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/number-base): Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal bases.
- [Color Picker & Converter](https://jsontools.space/tools/color): Pick colors and convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV. Generates CSS-ready values.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](https://jsontools.space/tools/gradient): Build linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients visually with a live preview. Add color stops, use presets, copy the generated CSS.
- [JWT Generator](https://jsontools.space/tools/jwt-generator): Generate signed JWT tokens with custom headers, payloads, and algorithms (HS256, HS384, HS512).
- [Markdown Preview](https://jsontools.space/tools/markdown-preview): Write or paste Markdown and see the rendered HTML instantly. Supports headings, code blocks, tables, and blockquotes.
- [Password Generator](https://jsontools.space/tools/password-generator): Generate cryptographically secure random passwords. Configurable length and character sets, bulk generation.
- [What is JSON?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-json): JSON explained — data types, syntax rules, and why it became the universal format for APIs and config files.
- [What is a JWT Token?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-jwt): JSON Web Tokens explained — structure, how they work, common algorithms, and security best practices.
- [What is Base64 Encoding?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-base64): Base64 explained — how it works, why it exists, common use cases, and the difference with Base64url.
- [How to Validate JSON](https://jsontools.space/guides/how-to-validate-json): What makes JSON valid, the most common errors, and how to go further with JSON Schema.
- [JSON vs YAML](https://jsontools.space/guides/json-vs-yaml): Side-by-side comparison of JSON and YAML — syntax, use cases, and when to choose one over the other.
- [What is a Regular Expression?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-regex): Regex explained — character classes, quantifiers, anchors, groups, and practical patterns for everyday use.
- [Cron Expression Examples](https://jsontools.space/guides/cron-expression-examples): Practical reference for cron syntax — field breakdown, special characters, and ready-to-use schedules.
- [What is Markdown?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-markdown): Markdown explained — how it works, core syntax, flavors (CommonMark, GFM), and where it is used.
- [Markdown Cheatsheet](https://jsontools.space/guides/markdown-cheatsheet): Quick reference for all Markdown syntax: headings, bold, italic, code blocks, links, lists, tables, blockquotes, and more.
- [What is URL Encoding?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-url-encoding): Percent-encoding explained — which characters must be encoded, how %XX works, and the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent.
- [What is a Hash Function?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-hash): Cryptographic hash functions explained — MD5 vs SHA-256, one-way property, use cases, and why raw SHA must not be used for passwords.
- [What is XML?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-xml): XML structure, elements, attributes, well-formed vs valid, XML vs JSON comparison, and where XML is still used today.
- [What is a UUID?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-uuid): UUID structure, versions (v1/v4/v7), uniqueness guarantees, and when to choose UUID over auto-increment integers.
- [What is JSON Schema?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-json-schema): JSON Schema core keywords, composition (anyOf/oneOf/allOf), Draft-07 vs 2020-12, and validation use cases.
- [What is YAML?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-yaml): YAML syntax (scalars, sequences, mappings, anchors), YAML vs JSON, and common gotchas like the Norway problem and tab prohibition.
- [Regex Cheatsheet](https://jsontools.space/guides/regex-cheatsheet): Quick reference for regex syntax — character classes, quantifiers, anchors, lookaheads, flags, and common patterns.
- [JSON Best Practices](https://jsontools.space/guides/json-best-practices): JSON API design conventions — naming, ISO dates, null vs omit, large numbers, pagination, error responses, and nesting depth.
- [What is CSV?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-csv): CSV structure, RFC 4180 quoting and escaping rules, comma vs semicolon vs tab delimiters, CSV vs JSON, and common Excel/encoding pitfalls.
- [What is a Unix Timestamp?](https://jsontools.space/guides/what-is-unix-timestamp): The Unix epoch, seconds vs milliseconds, the Year 2038 problem, and why leap seconds are not counted.
- [Understanding Number Bases](https://jsontools.space/guides/understanding-number-bases): Binary, octal, and hexadecimal explained, how to convert between them, and where each base shows up in real code.
- [Password Strength and Entropy Explained](https://jsontools.space/guides/password-entropy-explained): How password entropy is calculated, why length beats character-class complexity, and why human-invented passwords are weaker than the math suggests.
- [HEX, RGB, and HSL Explained](https://jsontools.space/guides/understanding-color-formats): How HEX, RGB, and HSL represent color, RGBA/HSLA transparency, and WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio thresholds.
- [SQL Cheatsheet](https://jsontools.space/guides/sql-cheatsheet): SQL clause execution order, joins, filtering, aggregates, and syntax differences between MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and T-SQL.
- [Encoding vs Encryption vs Hashing](https://jsontools.space/guides/encoding-vs-encryption-vs-hashing): What's reversible, what needs a key, and why Base64 encoding is not a form of encryption.

## Key Facts

- All tools run entirely in the browser (no server processing)
- No user accounts, no data storage, no cookies (except optional dark mode preference)
- Free to use with no rate limits
- Open source, maintained by flex-57: https://github.com/flex-57/json-tools
- About: https://jsontools.space/about
- Contact: https://jsontools.space/contact
- Available at: https://jsontools.space
